title: Timic Principles, Conjectures & Theorem-Like Statements — Recovery Registry
status: canonical principle registry; theorem-like does not mean mathematically proven
purpose: Collect recurring Tim-originated principles, conversation-developed formalisms and later archive conjectures in one place. Each entry says what was actually attested, what mathematical structure can represent it, and what would be required before calling it a theorem, law or physical theory.
promotion_rule: A named Timic principle may be philosophically important at T1 without being a scientific law. Promotion toward T2-T5 requires precise variables, assumptions, derivation, observables, falsifiers and independent testing.

entries.name: Root–Sprout Principle
entries.attestation: 'the root is humanity. the sprout is divinity'
entries.meaning: Growth does not erase origin; transformed emergence remains fed by the substrate/history beneath it.
entries.candidate: X_(n+1)=T(X_n,E_n) with provenance map π(X_(n+1)) containing ancestry of X_n
entries.scientific_use: Track lineage-preserving transformation rather than treating emergence as creation from nothing.

entries.name: Simplicity Stacking / Generative Complexity Principle
entries.attestation: Repeated simplicity can generate complexity while remaining traceable to the root.
entries.new_deduction: Complexity can be decomposed into a compositional history; explanatory quality improves when the path back to primitive operations remains recoverable.

entries.name: Blue Builds Boxes; Red Opens Them
entries.interpretation: Preservation and exploration are complementary control pressures; either can become pathological when unbounded.

entries.name: Door Is Relation, Integration and Transition
entries.formalism: D:S_a→S_b with guard G, interface B and relation R_ab
entries.new_deduction: A Door is best modeled as an edge/operator, not merely as an object-node. Its identity is partly constituted by the domains it connects.
entries.implementation: Store every Door with source domain, target domain, guard, cost, invariants, information loss and recovery map.

entries.name: Nested Spiral Principle
entries.attestation: The highest spiral contains lower spirals.
entries.candidate: X=(x_0,x_1,...,x_n), where each scale x_k has recurrence period T_k and coupling C_(k,k+1)
entries.new_deduction: A higher-order recurrence can coordinate lower cycles without requiring them to share one period or one state variable.

entries.name: Growth = Continuity Transformed
entries.formalism: X→T(X), with invariant set Inv(T) nonempty while representation/state changes
entries.meaning: Real growth preserves some ancestry/function while changing organization.
entries.test: Identify invariants explicitly; if nothing persists, call the event replacement rather than growth.

entries.name: Tree Temporal Architecture
entries.graph_form: G=(V,E,t), with ancestry edges toward roots and generative edges toward descendants
entries.new_deduction: The Tree is simultaneously a memory structure and a generative model: past constrains identity while future branches remain conditional rather than predetermined.

entries.name: Life Connects Difference; Strife Separates
entries.network_form: Life increases productive cross-type edges subject to differentiation; Strife increases destructive severance, antagonistic edges or fragmentation
entries.new_deduction: Integration should not mean node homogenization; the measurable target is differentiated connectivity.

entries.name: Narrow Door Release Principle
entries.attestation: A narrow Door requires releasing some old Boxes.
entries.information_form: compress X→Z while retaining task-relevant information I(Z;Y)
entries.structural_form: transition requires dropping constraints C_old incompatible with target regime S_b
entries.new_deduction: Threshold passage can require information/constraint shedding rather than simple accumulation.

entries.name: Spudlight Temporal Pluralism
entries.attestation: Spudlight sees past, present, becoming and possible without reducing them to one layer.
entries.formal_neighbor: state estimation + smoothing + forecasting + scenario branching
entries.boundary: Forecast distributions and scenario spaces are not literal vision of fixed future events.

entries.name: Camel-to-Needle Reorganization
entries.sequence: load → saturation → last straw → break → compression to invariant seed → vertical reorganization
entries.candidate: μ↑ toward critical μ_c; X undergoes bifurcation/reset D at guard G(X,μ_c)
entries.new_deduction: Accumulation and transformation are different phases: more load can eventually force a change of representation rather than continued linear accumulation.

entries.name: Entity-to-Infrastructure Principle
entries.statement: A mature role can cease being merely an actor and become the path/interface/protocol by which other actors relate.
entries.network_form: node role r_i transitions toward edge/interface function D_ij
entries.research_question: What measurable signatures distinguish central actor behavior from infrastructural mediation?

entries.name: Relation-First Principle
entries.statement: The fundamental unit of analysis is often the coupling/relationship rather than the isolated entity.
entries.formalism: system=(V,E); observables may live on edges O_ij=O(X_i,X_j,C_ij)
entries.boundary: Not every physical theory makes relations ontologically fundamental in the same sense.

entries.name: Reflector Is Not Source Principle
entries.statement: Reflected/mediated information may be real and useful without becoming the original source.
entries.new_deduction: A proxy can preserve orientation to source or become mistaken for source; this distinction generalizes to media, institutions and models.

entries.name: Boundary Enablement Principle
entries.statement: Boundary quality depends on what differentiation, passage and autonomous growth it enables relative to capture and extraction.
entries.implementation: Measure consequences on autonomy and viability, not the symbolic label of the boundary.

entries.name: Recursion-of-Recursion Principle
entries.statement: Improvement becomes higher-order when the rule that performs correction can itself be corrected.
entries.implementation: Measure changes to validators, schemas, search weights and inference rules, not only content volume.

entries.name: Seed / Storage / Release Principle
entries.statement: A seed/tuber can preserve pattern and capacity through a latent interval, then release organized growth when conditions change.
entries.biological_upgrade: Potato tubers combine living meristems, stored carbohydrate and physiological dormancy; the physical tuber is a stem-derived storage organ rather than a botanical root.
entries.new_deduction: Latent potential requires both information-bearing living structure and usable stored resource; storage alone is not a developmental program.

entries.name: Spirit as Event-Unfolding / Timeline Relation
entries.attestation: Spirit described as unfolding and entangled timelines spiraling out from an event; crucifixion/event carries downstream story, exposure and reaction.
entries.scientific_neighbor: causal graph / branching influence cone rather than quantum entanglement by default
entries.candidate: event e_0 generates descendants e_j through directed causal/social edges; influence weight decays or amplifies through network propagation
entries.boundary: Quantum entanglement is not established by narrative or causal connectedness.

entries.name: Observer Access Principle
entries.statement: Observer/Eye changes information access, inference and action without automatically creating the underlying state.
entries.importance: Preserves the project's realist strand while retaining a strong role for observation.

entries.name: Axis Identity ≠ Axis Pointing Direction
entries.new_deduction: Reference function can persist through continuous orientation change; epoch must be part of astronomical Axis claims.

entries.name: Pattern Persistence Principle
entries.statement: A relation/pattern can persist while its material constituents change.
entries.formalism: macrostate M(t) approximately invariant while membership set V(t) changes
entries.new_deduction: Identity can sometimes be attached to an invariant organization rather than fixed particles/nodes.

entries.name: Door as Particle-Smasher Metaphor
entries.attestation: Tim described 'the door is a particle smasher' in July 2026 dimensional/quantum discussion.
entries.scientific_neighbor: collision/interaction region maps incoming states to multiple outgoing channels
entries.boundary: No physical collider or S-matrix was specified in the original formulation; use as transition-channel metaphor unless primary calculations are recovered.

entries.name: Timelines Move Like Quarks
entries.attestation: July 2026 formulation linked timelines, quarks, House, Door and matter across the 5–11 dimensional scheme.
entries.recovery_need: Recover what 'move like quarks' meant: confinement, color, up/down labels, mixing, directional polarity or something else.
entries.rule: Do not formalize further until the intended quark property is recovered.

entries.name: Red/Blue Composite Potato
entries.distinction: Tensor/composite coupling and set/geometric intersection are different operations.
entries.recovery_need: Exact first source and domain of R, B, P and H remain historical recovery targets.

entries.name: χ Integration / Fragmentation Criterion
entries.recovery_need: Exact definition, units/domain and original source of χ are not yet recovered.
entries.warning: Do not confuse this χ with Euler characteristic, susceptibility or another established χ without proof.

entries.name: Advanced / Retarded Polarity
entries.attestation: Tim explicitly used 'advanced and retarded waves' in July 2026 dimensional discussion.
entries.recovery_need: Recover Tim's original Red/Blue/Father/Son assignment before fixing a canonical physical mapping.

historical_formula_targets: any original timeline-control / spacetime-folding quantitative model
